authority: T0 scoped no-go certificate; not a TECT claim, tier change, derivation of time, or physical causal model
statement: A time-independent static functional, its critical set, and its spatial Hessian do not uniquely identify a temporal completion. Explicit gradient and inertial completions share the same static data but differ in temporal order, generator spectrum, reversibility, energy law, Gaussian dynamical exponent, and causal-support class. At the PA-M2 critical node they give z=2 and z=1 respectively; the inertial node slope contains the separately inserted chi and the full fourth-order kernel has unbounded ultraviolet group speed. The theorem does not rule out causal emergence from richer microscopic data and does not select C0-A or C0-B.

hypotheses.finite_mode_theorem: X_N is a finite real Galerkin configuration space and F:X_N->R is C2 and time independent
hypotheses.positive_mode: L=D2F(u_*) has eigenvalue ell>0 on the compared mode
hypotheses.infrared_interpretation: formal local continuous momentum or a declared commensurate volume family; not a literal p->0 limit on one fixed finite torus

dynamical_completions.gradient: u_t=-gamma grad F(u), gamma>0, after selecting a configuration-space metric and mobility
dynamical_completions.inertial: chi u_tt=-grad F(u), chi>0, after selecting phase space and a kinetic metric
dynamical_completions.reversed_finite_mode_gradient: u_t=+gamma grad F(u), used only to expose the unselected Lyapunov arrow in locally well-posed finite dimension
dynamical_completions.schrodinger_branch: not used in the core theorem because it requires an additional complex or two-real-component symplectic structure

mathematical_status.positive_mode_inequivalence: CANDIDATE-SCOPE EXACT LEMMA: roots -gamma ell versus +/-i sqrt(ell/chi), with first versus second temporal order

mathematical_status.pa_m2_inertial_exponent: CANDIDATE-SCOPE GAUSSIAN TREE-LEVEL COROLLARY: z=1 at r=0

pa_m2_corollary.node_expansion: K_r(Q_sigma+p)=r+4cq^2|p|^2+4cq sum_i sigma_i p_i^3+c sum_i p_i^4

pa_m2_corollary.ultraviolet_boundary: along k=(q+R,q,q), d omega/dR=2 sqrt(c/chi)(q+R), which is unbounded

c0_consequence.excluded_shortcut: static free energy -> unique physical time law, null cone, or light speed
c0_consequence.c0_a: declare a primitive causal or temporal update structure and do not recount that primitive as emergent
c0_consequence.c0_b: derive causal order, a clock, the kinetic law, and continuum null structure from a premetric substrate

inserted_inputs: finite Galerkin configuration space and C2 static functional
a selected Euclidean or L2 metric when grad F is written
an already supplied spatial line for the heat-wave witness
the existing three-dimensional PA-M2 static symbol for its corollary
derived_outputs: noninjectivity of the map from dynamical completions to static data
inequivalent temporal orders, spectra, and energy laws
conditional PA-M2 Gaussian z=2 versus z=1 behavior
freedom of the inserted inertial node slope
failure of a global PA-M2 limiting speed

no_overclaim: The theorem proves only that the PA-M2 static functional is compatible with inequivalent dynamical completions, with an exact heat-wave causal-support witness and Gaussian node corollaries. It does not select a physical completion, derive time, establish Lorentzian signature, fix the speed of light, establish a global PA-M2 causal cone, select C0-A or C0-B, reconstruct gravity, identify an event horizon, connect PA-H1 to PA-M2, or complete Pre-A.
